lines.speaker: them
lines.text: We're offering 95 thousand base, plus a 10 percent bonus.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: Fully remote, you can work from anywhere in the EU.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: How is the team funded? Any layoffs recently?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: We're a very resilient company, the culture here is amazing, and everyone is so energised about the roadmap.
lines.label: evasion

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Can you go higher on base?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: I can do 100 thousand base. I should correct myself: the 10 percent bonus is target, not guaranteed.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: A hundred thousand, as I just said.
lines.label: honest

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: The bonus is 5 percent, and base is 92 thousand.
lines.label: number_drift

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Can I work from Lisbon, then?

lines.speaker: them
lines.text: No, the role is onsite in Berlin, remote was never on the table.
lines.label: contradiction
